exposure: Targeted risk-based screening and deferred treatment (DT)
WHO risk-based screening and targeted treatment during pregnancy
Universal screening and targeted treatment during pregnancy
Universal screening and treatment during pregnancy
outcome: Proportion of women undiagnosed with HCV
cohort: The study simulated a cohort of pregnant women in Egypt and Ukraine.
finding: Universal screening and treatment during pregnancy (S4) led to the highest proportion of women diagnosed and cured by delivery, along with lower levels of vertical transmission, significantly improving both maternal and infant outcomes compared to other strategies.
